{{Top|leg}}
'''Power access interfaces''' were used to plug devices and appliances into a compatible power grid. Interfaces differed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], necessitating the use of [[power adaptor]]s to match the [[power coupling]] and rating of an individual's devices.
